waits.coldStart: process launch → page-library drawn and the novel shelf offers the 10 MiB TXT
waits.uiFeedback: dispatched sidebar click (the library entry, the search button, the notes' records) → DOM commit of the target: the library tab, the search box' input, the records tab (4 ms polling, window shown)
waits.railSwitch: dispatched click on the icon of a view in the rail → DOM commit of the docked sidebar listing the view (its rows or its empty sentence drawn, no loading line left), every view of the rail in turn, 4 rounds
waits.searchNames: names typed into the search box's input (native setter and input event) → the first name results drawn and the box not busy; the box opened from the home's sidebar and closed with Esc for each sample
waits.settingsEnterLeave: dispatched click on the rail's settings → the settings directory and page drawn; dispatched click on the back arrow → the settings view gone and the focused tab's panel of the workspace drawn again (both directions are samples)
waits.largeTail: card click → the work's page → read click → the tail marker restored from stored progress is on the page shown (inside the reading area, not only in the text loaded around it)
waits.saveReceipt: insertText in the note editor (opened from the notes' records tab) → data-save-state leaves and returns to saved
waits.duringParse: same UI and save samples, kept only while a 10 MiB import is still parsing

notes: Indexed first screen reads an already stored revision. Reparse imports a text file again. duringParseMs is workspace.get while a worker parse is in flight. Service contentAvailableMs and saveReceiptMs remain operation receipts. Window contentAvailableMs, saveReceiptMs and importToReadableMs wait until the packaged or built Electron renderer shows the library page, the readable text, or a committed note save state. This file is a self-check, not product acceptance.
